title: 2026 UK GHG domestic wood combustion methodology QA controls

sources.title: UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 2026 planned methodology changes
Final UK greenhouse gas emissions statistics: 1990 to 2024

facts.source_fact: Domestic wood combustion estimates use new DUKES data.
The new data separates changes attributable to heating degree days.
The new data also separates stock impacts.
Previously HDD effects were inferred using adjusted and unadjusted domestic gas use data.
facts.expected_handling: Do not mix legacy proxy with revised method.

facts.source_fact: The revised method uses a direct breakdown of domestic wood-use impacts.
The change concerns domestic wood combustion, not all domestic fuels.
The change is exclusive to buildings and product uses.
The method change produces a small decrease in 2023 emissions.
The methodology change is applied within the national inventory time series.
The planned-method note is provisional relative to the final release.
facts.expected_handling: Use final release for final values.
